Bipasha Basu Returns to Acting in Hansal Mehta Series

Actress Bipasha Basu is returning to acting after a six-year hiatus. She will star in a new web series directed by Hansal Mehta, which has commenced filming. The series also features Sunny Kaushal and Vishal Jethwa.
